scope: Analytic bounds only; no graph, neural input fitting or prospective training.

up.assumption: Identical isolated pulse map with negligible intervening traces; scalar gain crossing, not behavioral reversal.

down.assumption: Identical isolated pulse map with negligible intervening traces; scalar gain crossing, not behavioral reversal.

assumptions: KC input remains exactly zero for the entire future interval
DAN rate and both response states stay in [0,R]
Only the declared local gain equation acts; initial KC trace is eNow
Quiet-gap examples assume KC remains zero and eBeforeGap <= 1; no CPU rest-to-model-time conversion

limitation: Shared KC activity invalidates the inactive-cue premise. Static cue separation and existing all-legal overlap do not establish behavioral retention.
